page.overview:
What is Where the Wild Things Are?

Where the Wild Things Are is the ninth song from the 1997 album ReLoad. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Jason Newsted, and has a length of 6:54. It's the only song in the album co-written by Newsted, as well as the last song he would receive writing credit for within his time in the band.

The subject matter of the song is about a kid who is growing up but isn't quite prepared for what the world has in store. Being sent off to "war" could mean going to a tough and mean place.

"Where the Wild Things Are" has never been performed live.

So wake up, sleepy one It's time to save your world
